hard_gates: A metric is not operational without exact formula, unit, aggregation, window, dimensions, data source, owner, baseline, target or threshold, bias, and linked decision or action.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
Trace classification describes observed behavior only; it cannot infer root cause, authorize reuse, or expand beyond the approved sample, fields, retention, and deletion boundary.

responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Define an evidence-linked metric system of outcomes, inputs, secondary and guardrail metrics with baselines, instrumentation contracts, dashboards, and alert recommendations without provider mutation.; Classify authorized production LLM traces into evidence-backed behavior and failure categories while preserving provenance, uncertainty, minority cases, and governance.
